title: GET /api/procedures-v2/pm-plans/services accepts another company's pm_standard_id with no 403 tenancy gate on QA
impact: A caller can aim the covered-services endpoint at a foreign tenant's PM standard id and the route falls through instead of refusing it.

title: A failed Fill-Forms "Read pages" job returns the raw AWS ECS/Fargate task descriptor in job.error and the dialog renders it verbatim
area: Fill Forms from Photos / error handling
impact: Any authenticated user can read the AWS account id, cluster ARN, ECR image, subnet, ENI, MAC and private IP from a persisted failed job, and the error is unreadable to the user.
quote: when the agent-runner task does die, the backend stores the raw ECS `Cause` in `job.error` and hands it to the client, and the dialog renders it.

title: Cross-tenant CREATE is still accepted on both the offline/queued path and the online `x-direct-write:true` path — a Company-A user files a task row under a Company-B `sld_id` and it appears in Company B's Tasks page
impact: The victim tenant gets a real row it never created (counted in its PENDING tile, and carried into its reports, SLD sync and mobile client); the update/delete half of the fix does not cover create.
quote: Cross-tenant **CREATE**: **applies → this ticket.** 🔴

title: A failed Fill-from-Photos job returns the raw AWS ECS/Fargate task descriptor verbatim in `job.error` from `/api/form-fill/jobs/{id}/status` (and `/jobs/active`), and the dialog renders it
area: Fill Forms from Photos / infrastructure disclosure
impact: AWS account id, cluster ARN, ECR image, VPC subnet, ENI, MAC, private IP and internal DNS reach the browser; failed jobs persist so the leak is permanently re-servable, and the user gets an unreadable error.
quote: once any job has failed, this leak is permanently and deterministically reproducible via the steps above, independent of the crash

title: Review-dialog `questions[].fields[]` and `gaps` descriptors omit `options` for option-typed fields (select/radio/multiselect), so the typed input cannot render a picker and the field's own label reaches apply as the value
area: Fill Forms from Photos / review dialog contract
impact: The reviewer gets no real picker for e.g. Verdict; the answer degrades to the label ('Verdict') and apply rejects it, even though `field_index` for the same path carries the option keys.
quote: The question descriptor is `{"label":"Verdict","path":"verdict.verdict","section":"Verdict","type":"select","unit":null}` — **no `options`** (same for `gaps` entries). The `field_index` entry for the identical path **has** them

title: `POST /api/plans/{id}/generate` silently accepts an orphaned walk-scoped instruction set (`site_walk_id` removed while a work row still declares `scope:"site_walk"`) — HTTP 200 `success:true`, and regenerating zeroes a priced quote from $600 to $0.00
impact: A priced customer quote can be silently emptied through the plan editor's own save path (the editor re-sends exactly this payload once the walk id is lost) with a success response and no warning anywhere.
quote: Step 3 returns **HTTP 200 with `"success": true`, no `error` and no `code`** — and no soft warning anywhere … The acceptance is completely silent.

title: `POST /api/plans/{id}/generate` performs no instruction validation at all — a garbage `scope`, a missing/nonexistent `service_id`, a row with no `id`, a payload with no `version`, and `scope:"assets"` with no asset source all return HTTP 200
impact: Any malformed plan-revision payload is persisted verbatim on the REST generate path, so incoherent instruction sets can only be discovered by their downstream effects.
quote: All returned 200. There appears to be **no instruction validation on this REST path at all**.

title: Site Walks feature gate is sidebar-only — a company without the `site-walks` feature loads the full Site Walks surface (with an enabled "New Site Walk" button) by typing `/site-walks`, and `/api/site-walk/list` returns HTTP 200 too
impact: The app tells the user "Site Walks isn't enabled for your company" in the sidebar and then serves the entire unentitled feature one URL away, with its create action live and no server-side entitlement check.
quote: Net: the app tells the user *"Site Walks isn't enabled for your company"* in the sidebar, then serves them the entire feature one URL away. The sidebar gate (`Layout.jsx`) landed; the route-table gate (`navigation.js`) did not.

title: `details_by_key` is keyed on unnormalised free-text property names — empty-string, trailing-whitespace and case-variant keys (`Reference Temp` vs `Reference Temp␣␣`) make template lookups silently miss
impact: A template keying on the clean name renders a blank cell with no error for every issue stored under a whitespace or case variant — a recurring "field randomly missing from report" failure class.
quote: A template keying `details_by_key["Reference Temp"]` silently misses every issue stored under `"Reference Temp  "` — blank cell, no error.

title: Report-config write authz mismatch: UI locks the Super Admin role but PUT/fork/ai-edit on /api/reporting/configs/{id} accept it (frontend gates on role name, backend on reports.manage)
impact: A customer Super Admin can bypass the product's internal-EG-Admin-only lock by calling the API directly — renaming, forking and launching AI edit jobs on report configs the UI refuses to unlock for that role.
quote: Super Admin → **200 write accepted**, despite #1085 locking that exact role in the UI. … **Actual:** 200, the rename persists. **Expected (if the UI lock reflects the security model):** 403/422 refusal.

title: /api/eg-forms paginated rows silently drop definition, html_template and sample_data (24 keys unpaginated vs 21 paginated) with no flag, null or fields parameter
impact: Any caller that paginates (including scripts, integrators and the mobile client) sees every form as having an empty definition and cannot distinguish "not included" from "empty" — it already produced a false QA finding of "344/344 forms have empty definitions".
quote: Fields present unpaginated but missing when paginated: `definition`, `html_template`, `sample_data` — i.e. the entire form body. The paginated row is a summary projection, but nothing in the response says so

title: /api/forms has no working pagination at all — page, page_size, per_page and limit are all ignored and every request returns 169 rows / 5.60 MB
impact: No cap and no small default on a 5.6 MB collection: every integrator, script or mobile caller pulls the whole payload on every request, violating the project's own api-contract rules.
quote: Every parameter combination returns the full 5.6 MB. No `page`, `page_size`, `per_page` or `limit` form has any effect. There is no cap and no small default — the contract's three core rules are all unmet on this endpoint.

title: /api/eg-forms silently discards page_size unless page is also supplied, and its no-param default is unbounded (344 rows / 3.69 MB)
impact: A caller that asks for 5 rows receives 3.69 MB with no error or warning while believing it is paginating; the collection default is unbounded instead of the contract's small default.
quote: **`page_size` is silently ignored unless `page` is also supplied.** A caller asking for 5 rows receives 3.69 MB and **no error and no warning** — the parameter is accepted and discarded. Silent parameter-dropping is the worst failure mode here: the client believes it is paginating.

title: A tenant Super Admin can PUT a global (is_global true, company_id null) service's site-walk-config and change the shared pricing formula, even though the UI only offers "Customize" (fork)
impact: One tenant's admin can rewrite pricing formulas on a globally shared service that every tenant prices against; the UI's fork-before-edit rule is the only thing stopping it.
quote: yet `PUT /api/procedures-v2/services/d625cfa0…/site-walk-config` from the acme Super Admin returned **200** and changed the shared formula ... The UI's fork-before-edit rule is not enforced server-side.

title: The bulk "Apply PM Plans" dialog gives no pre-apply warning that de-energized lines will be skipped on never-shutdown assets - a 4-service plan silently wrote 1 service per asset, disclosed only by a few-second toast
area: Asset PM programs / Assets-list bulk configurator
impact: At the scale where the shutdown gate matters most, a user commits a plan believing all its services were scheduled; 6 of 8 schedules were dropped and nothing durable records it.
quote: the bulk dialog shows none of the "Won't be set up — can never shut down" labels the single-asset dialog shows — the dialog is one shared component and the /assets call site simply never passes the asset's shutdown restriction to it ... that warning is pushed as a **toast that lasts a few seconds**

title: No method on the tenant carries updates_panel_schedule, so with _execute_swaps deleted no schedule_update task can ever be minted - panel-schedule changes have neither an automatic nor a manual path
impact: A schedule change is now only recorded when someone completes a schedule_update task, and no such task can be created on QA, so SCCR panel fixes leave the panel schedule un-updated by any route.
quote: With no method flagged, no such task can be minted — so on this tenant the old automatic path is gone and the new manual one cannot fire either.

title: There is no route from the workbench drawer to an issue's full page, and /issues/{id} reached directly renders with no Back control or breadcrumb at all
impact: A user who lands on an issue's full page has no in-app way back to Pull-Through Work or the register - only the browser control - and the origin-aware back this ticket adds has nothing to attach to.
quote: as it stands the drawer is the only way in and there is no way out of the full page except the browser control.

title: The corrective fix catalog's 53 methods ("Issue Resolution — Any Asset") carry no eg_form_keys and no unit_attribute, so no break/fix form can be rendered or generated and corrective fixes cannot scale by sections
impact: Every corrective work order generated from a basic fix comes with no break/fix form to fill in, and multi-section gear prices a single section - the two things this ticket claims to add are absent on QA.
quote: the corrective fix flow's 53 methods carry **no `unit_attribute` at all** and **no `eg_form_keys`** ... Neither is present here, which is why steps 2–5 could not be run.

title: /maintenance/program and /maintenance/overview render for every role by URL because no maintenance.* permission exists for a route guard to check
impact: A Technician, PM, Account Manager or Admin with no Maintenance entry in the rail types the URL and gets the site's full maintenance record (90 assets, condition index, unresolved issue titles, activity log); the same sessions correctly get Access Denied on /users and /labor, proving the guard exists but is not applied here. Re-confirmed still open on 2026-08-27.
quote: a Technician with no Maintenance entry in the rail opens `/maintenance/overview` and gets the site's full maintenance record — 90 assets, condition index 99/100, unresolved issue titles, maintenance activity log.

title: The CURRENT SITE picker is absent on /maintenance/program (0 comboboxes) although the page content is site-scoped
impact: On a site that has a real program, the user is looking at one site's maintenance plan with no way to switch site - they must leave the page, change site elsewhere and navigate back. Confirmed for all six roles; /maintenance/overview for the same site still renders the picker.
quote: `/maintenance/program` still renders **0 comboboxes**, while `/maintenance/overview` for the same site renders **2** (the CURRENT SITE picker).

title: The Customers nav item is gated by two different flags: PM sees it under Operations without features.accounts.view while FM holds the identical permission pair and gets no nav entry at all
impact: Facility Manager is entitled to /customers (page renders, Create Site available) but the link exists in no rail category, and under the V1.36 rail only the open category's links are in the DOM, so the route is undiscoverable and the URL must be typed; PM's mirror-image case fails RolePermissionUiGatingTest.
quote: The Facility Manager is entitled to the page and can use it, but has no navigation path to it.

title: The Created column on /sessions and /emps advertises itself as sortable but never reorders, changes aria-sort or issues a request
impact: There is no way to list Work Orders or EMPs oldest-first; three clicks leave aria-sort at descending with 0 requests, while control columns (Due Date, Site) on the same grids sort correctly.
quote: `Created` loads descending and stays there. Three clicks produce no reorder, no `aria-sort` change and no request. There is no way to list either grid oldest-first.

title: Technician still holds quotes.approve, accounts.manage and data.export (92 perms) after the platform.web revocation, so the role stays over-privileged on mobile
impact: The 2026-08-27 fix only dropped platform.web; a field technician retains quote-approval, account-management and data-export rights, which still apply on the mobile client (and left the role's permission count above the Project Manager's 90).
quote: the fix dropped `platform.web` only — the Technician still holds `quotes.approve`, `accounts.manage`, `data.export`. Harmless on web now; still applies on mobile.

title: GET /reporting/status/<arn> describes any Step Functions execution whose ARN the caller holds and hands back its download URL
impact: Holding another tenant's execution ARN is enough to read that report's status and download link - no caller-company check; author-flagged, deferred and still unfiled.
quote: `GET /reporting/status/<arn>` describes any execution whose ARN you hold and returns its download URL.

title: The RBAC permission-matrix contract test diffs live QA against a 2026-06-15 production CSV export, so it reports 59 undiagnosable drifted cells and keeps the rbac-* workflows red
impact: The suite's failure count (33 reported by CI, 59 actually measured across all 6 roles) mixes genuine drift, prod-vs-QA divergence and ten weeks of legitimate product change, so nobody can act on it - rbac-* workflows have been majority-red since July with no triage.
quote: Until then the suite reports a number nobody can act on — which is why `rbac-*` workflows have been majority-red since July without anyone triaging them.

title: Cross-tenant CREATE is still allowed on the offline/queued mutation path: a queued POST /api/task/create with a foreign sld_id plants a real row inside the victim tenant
impact: A tampered create from tenant A lands a live task under tenant B's site, visible in the victim's Tasks page and PENDING tile, and flows into their reports, SLD sync and mobile app.
quote: queue a `POST …/create` with a client-generated id and the *victim's* `sld_id`, and the row lands in the victim tenant. Reproduced 2/2.

title: POST /api/node/create accepts a non-existent node_class UUID and creates the asset with a dangling class reference rendered as "No Class"
impact: Assets can be created pointing at a class that does not exist, so nothing enforces referential integrity on the class FK.
quote: The **non-existent class UUID being accepted** is a second, smaller integrity gap worth its own look.

title: aic_rating = 0 is accepted, persisted as a real value and exported to SKM as ShortCircuitRating 0.000
impact: A physically meaningless zero bus bracing rating reaches SKM as an explicit value rather than missing data, on web, iOS and bulk import alike.
quote: **`0` is still accepted** and still exports as `ShortCircuitRating 0.000` — reproduced with a real SKM file. This is the one substantive open item.

title: Bulk Import review step lists out-of-range AIC values (-5, 2147483648) as ordinary changes with no validation warning, though the browser field rejects them outright

title: Upload Anything dialog renders the raw Python exception payload (driver.py paths, line numbers, requestId) to the end user, twice, with no human-readable message
impact: Customers see internal file paths and stack traces instead of an explanation, and are never told the issues and photos were extracted before the failure.

area: Fill Forms from Photos / proposal contract
impact: Unread option fields degrade to an unpopulated input; the value 'Verdict' (the label) was submitted and refused by apply, so the user cannot answer that question.
quote: So `type` alone tells the dialog *"render a picker"* while giving it nothing to populate it with, unless it cross-references `field_index` by path.

impact: Once the walk id is lost every subsequent editor save re-sends the orphaned state, so a priced walk quote silently collapses to 0 work orders and $0.00 with no error or warning anywhere in the response; the same endpoint also accepts arbitrary scopes, missing service_ids and nonexistent service UUIDs.

title: Site Walks feature gate misses the navigation.js route table: on a tenant without the site-walks feature, typing /site-walks renders the complete surface with an enabled "New Site Walk" button
impact: The sidebar tells the user the feature is not enabled for their company and a typed, bookmarked or shared URL then serves them the whole unentitled feature, including create.
quote: So the app tells the user *"Site Walks isn't enabled for your company"* in the sidebar and then serves them the entire feature one URL away.

title: GET /api/tasks/all (PR #872's own deliverable) returns HTTP 500 on every request and is called by nothing in the Tasks UI
impact: The merged endpoint is non-functional: every call 500s with a fresh trace_id, polluting error monitoring and breaking any external caller, while All Facilities silently rides on POST /api/v2/tasks/list instead.
quote: `GET /api/tasks/all` — the endpoint PR #872 exists to provide — returns **HTTP 500 on every call** and is called by **nothing** in the Tasks UI.

title: AI service-spec build jobs stick in status "running" for 21-24 hours with error:null and no applied version, leaving a permanent "building" state in the UI
impact: Two of four QA build jobs never reached a terminal state, so the service shows as building forever with no error the user can act on.

title: Condition Assessment (/pm-readiness) prints the raw permission error as page content - "API call failed: 422 - {error: permission_denied}" - for Client Portal and Electrical Engineer
impact: Two roles (one of them customer-facing) see a raw API error string instead of the Access Denied card that already exists elsewhere in the app.

impact: An engineer opening the asset reads an unmatched, AI-invented manufacturer/model as a real designation, while the grid honestly shows Device = "—".

impact: Site scoping is enforced on the list endpoint but not on the detail endpoints, so any signed-in role can read WO details (and the owning account name) for sites they were never assigned; the two halves of the contract disagree.

title: Client Portal dashboard advertises "22 Active Work Orders" and /auth/me grants sessions.view + workorders.view, but there is no Work Orders nav route and /sessions/{id} returns Access Denied - even for a WO on the site their own account owns

quote: the just-created asset is NOT listed (only pre-existing assets), so the issue can't be attached to it. ... Confirmed: after a page reload the same picker lists both assets.

title: A user_checked service with no data_mask column (Arc Flash Label Placement) gets no per-asset checkbox anywhere on web - its lines can only be ticked via Select all -> Mark As..
impact: For the formless checklist services the ticket names, completion can be recorded in bulk but never seen or done per asset - and with the row-selection defect the other bulk route is dead too.

title: A real interrupting-kA conflict (node AIC 65 kA vs bound frame kaic 25 kA) produces only an ordinary amber warning - eqp_lib.critical_warnings was never populated across 3 bulk runs / 6 assets
impact: The red "Critical mismatch — needs review" treatment is wired and correct but unreachable from the product on QA, so a genuine safety-relevant kA mismatch is presented to reviewers as ordinary incomplete information.
quote: the node now carries `aic_rating 65` vs `frame.kaic 25` and renders amber "Incomplete", not red. Across 3 runs / 6 assets, `critical_warnings` was never populated.

title: The work-order details-panel restore (showDetailsInCompact, PR #1391) exists only on cicd/qa, so the next dev->qa promotion will revert it
impact: The regression the PR fixes will come back on the next promotion and would still vanish from prod, unless the change lands on cicd/dev first.

impact: The missing walk-pointer check is one instance of a broader no-validation gap on the quote save path, so any malformed instruction is stored and silently regenerates a wrong quote.

quote: V1.36 swapped the *names* Admin ↔ Super Admin on unchanged role ids, so every one of these is one rename away from silently changing who gets in.

title: No rate limiting on POST /api/auth/login — ten consecutive failed logins all returned 401 with no 429/423/403 at any point
impact: No IP or global throttling is observable on the QA host; already tracked as ZP-2025 and the test is kept red as a tripwire (caveats: non-existent account, so per-account lockout would not trip, and QA has no WAF/edge).
